name: Library Integrity Audit Route Hotfix
changes: Registers the read-only /api/automation/library/integrity-audit endpoint in the HTTP GET handler so the v3.6.43 Library Integrity Review UI and Diagnostic Collector can retrieve the audit instead of receiving HTTP 404.
Keeps Library Integrity Open Folder and Mark Missing actions POST-only; Mark Missing remains non-destructive and never deletes, moves, renames, or overwrites media.
Adds a production regression guard that fails if the integrity-audit route is missing from GET or is accidentally reintroduced into POST.
regression_guards: All v3.6.43 TV identity compatibility, strict cross-series rejection, reviewed-fingerprint protection, diagnostics compaction, and client-disconnect behavior remain unchanged.
The integrity audit remains read-only; only explicit user actions use POST.
The existing 30-case TV identity/reliability regression suite remains mandatory in the canonical GitHub release workflow.
v3.6.42 storage reserve/reservation hygiene and v3.6.41 fail-soft Downloads snapshot behavior remain intact.
The v3.6.20+ serialized private-SAB transport remains intact.
